title: Unit 42: autonomous 'Cairn' operations hit semiconductor, defense and civil-society targets
what_changed: Summary, plain and key findings said the US teachers' union "lost" or had "taken" over 1 million member records; Unit 42's report says the framework "logged access to more than one million member records". Reworded to the report's wording; plain now says "at least 19" organisations; the 150,000-documents figure, not re-found, was dropped; the AgentBeam tracker was removed from sources.
